title: The Last of Baishan - How to Earn & Missable Status
description: The Last of Baishan trophy in Phantom Blade Zero - how to earn it, whether it is missable, and how the PS5 and Steam lists differ.
keyword: The Last of Baishan phantom blade zero trophy

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Missable. It has to be accepted before the Bai Chilian fight, not after - accepting it late is the single most common way this one is lost.

sections.title: How to Earn
sections.content: Complete the side quest Secrets of the Baishan Sect.

sections.title: Source Status
sections.content: Trophy 20 of 36 on the list - before it Even Trees Know Sorrow · after it Together Till the End. It is missable, and the checklist of everything that expires is on the guide. The full list with rarity is on the trophy list; the Platinum route and the order to do things in are on the trophy guide.
